::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
STMicroelectronics' China-for-China twin of its Catania 200mm SiC strategy: an 8-inch automotive SiC device fab built in ~20 months (per ST's CEO), line activated 27 February 2025, and reported by March 2026 as China's first 8-inch automotive-grade SiC line to reach volume production (2,000 wafers/week). JV entity formed August 2023; total project investment ~¥23 billion (~$3.2B) plus ¥7 billion for the co-located Chongqing Sanan substrate plant (activated September 2024).
:::

**Chinese name:** 安意法半导体有限公司 (Ānyìfǎ Bàndǎotǐ Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

## What does this facility make?

8-inch car-grade SiC MOSFET epi and die, ST-branded, feeding Chinese EV makers' main-drive inverters.

## Why does it matter?

The clearest case of a Western IDM localizing advanced power-device manufacturing inside China for the Chinese market — a structural answer to 'de-risking' pressure — and Chongqing's anchor in its EV-supply-chain buildout around Changan.

## Project Timeline

- **Aug 2023** — JV company established in Chongqing Xiyong micro-electronics park
- **Sep 2024** — Companion Chongqing Sanan 8-inch substrate plant activated
- **Feb 2025** — 8-inch SiC device line activated (通线 ceremony, Xinhua)
- **Mar 2026** — Volume production of the 2,000 wafers/week car-grade line reported (China first)
